failure_summary.description: Overextended or mismatched the conventional answer form, such as adding name components or using the wrong number (trajectories 1, 2, 4, and 7).
Returned a subtype or material/property instead of the answer category requested by the clue (trajectories 3 and 8).
The partial-name instruction encouraged returning only the blank component when the expected answer was the complete conventional entity name (trajectory 6).
A bare personal-name prompt expected an associated country, but did not state that relation explicitly (trajectory 5).

patch.reasoning: Most form and answer-slot errors are already covered by the skill, so repeating those rules would not address a clear gap. The partial-name instruction is too broad for fill-in clues asking for a named entity as a whole; revise it to distinguish that case from prompts explicitly asking for only a name part. The bare-name prompt does not support a safe general rule about which association to return.

edits.target: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound. For partial-name prompts, give only the requested unknown name part. Omit components already stated in the question unless they are needed for unambiguous identification.
edits.content: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound unless the clue asks for the full conventional name of a named entity. For a partial-name prompt that explicitly asks for the unknown component, give only that part; when the answer slot is the named entity itself, return its complete conventional name even if some components appear in the clue.
